title: Federated Identity & Key Custody — PRD addendum, scope deltas, and gate criteria
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Addendum to the Private Deployment PRD clarifying federated SSO (SAML) flows, RBAC boundaries for key custodians, audit log schema/retention, and operator acceptance gates for KMS/HSM integrations. This ticket codifies scope deltas requested by two pilot customers (FinEdge and HealthCo) and defines the test/evidence bundle required for compliance onboarding and production sign-off.
scope_changes: Included: full SAML metadata exchange automation (metadata push/pull) for 2 IdP types (AzureAD, Okta) — originally manual.
Included: HSM-backed key wrapping for customer master keys with quorum 2-of-3 — added after FinEdge compliance ask.
Removed: built-in UI key-rotation wizard in initial private launch (deferred to release+2) to reduce scope for Q1 rollout.
Clarified: audit log retention default 1 year with configurable override up to 7 years (customers choose).
decision_log: 2025-02-14 — PM decision: Require IdP metadata push API and fallback to manual metadata upload; engineering to implement metadata validation hooks.
2025-02-20 — Security: HSM integration will use PKCS#11 v2.40 and support vendor plugins for AWS CloudHSM and Thales; HSM quorum set to 2-of-3 for key unwrapping; deferred HSM replication features.

2025-02-25 — Compliance: Audit schema must include immutable event_id, entity_id, actor_id, client_cert_fingerprint, and ksyms (key operation symbols) for every key operation; logs shall be exportable in newline-delimited JSON (ndjson).
2025-03-01 — Tradeoff: To meet pilot timeline, we will ship KMS server-side envelope encryption with customer-wrapped CMKs and provide HSM operator mode as a beta flagged feature.
2025-03-03 — Rollout: Canary in 1 region for Dedicated customers with SAML federation; Private VPC on-boarding will require preflight checks documented below.
rbac_summary: RBAC matrix (high level): owner -> full key and config management, operator -> deploy/upgrade runtimes and rotate node keys (no CMK export), auditor -> read-only access to audit logs and key operation metadata, security-admin -> grant/revoke roles and approve customer KMS bindings.
saml_requirements: SAML flows: SP-initiated and IdP-initiated supported. Required SAML attributes: email, name, groups. EntityID pattern must be 'https://console.redwood.local/{org_id}'. Certificates: support X.509 PEM with rotation window >= 7 days. Metadata exchange: support both metadata push (preferred) and manual metadata file upload with validation report.
kms_hsm_notes: KMS model: envelope encryption where CMKs are customer-owned. HSM mode: PKCS#11 interface for private deployments, customer HSM plugin driver registration during onboarding, rotation cadence policy default 90 days for node keys, CMK rotation controlled by customer. Escrow: optional key escrow for enterprise legal use via sealed-wrapped export to a customer HSM key.
audit_and_observability: Audit schema: event_time (ISO8601), event_id (uuidv4), actor, actor_role, action, target_resource, request_id, token_id_hash (sha256), client_cert_fingerprint, key_operation (wrap|unwrap|rotate|delete), outcome (success|failure), region. Retention: default 365 days; export to S3/GCS and SIEM via webhooks/OTLP. Console: per-route audit counts and anomaly alerting (thresholds configurable).
acceptance_criteria: Preflight checklist executes and validates SAML metadata exchange (push or upload) with automated cert and endpoint checks.
RBAC roles enforce key operation permissions in private deployment (tested via integration harness with sample roles).
Audit logs emitted for each KMS operation and available via API and console; ndjson export validated for schema correctness and retention settings honored.
HSM mode successfully performs a 2-of-3 quorum unwrap during key use in lab integration tests; logs capture quorum participants' fingerprints.
Security review completed and documented (security_review_required=true) including threat model update and PR review from security team.
Pilot customer (FinEdge) completes onboarding runbook end-to-end and signs acceptance artifact (link below).
test_plan: Integration tests: SAML handshake automation with test IdPs (Okta dev org, Azure AD test tenant); RBAC role enforcement tests using infra test harness; HSM PKCS#11 integration smoke tests with CloudHSM emulator and Thales simulator; Audit schema validation via ndjson comparator; Load test to ensure metadata push scales to 200 orgs/hour.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): Dedicated region us-west with 5 pilot orgs, feature-flag HSM=false, monitoring dashboards enabled. Phase 2: Private VPC customers -- sign compliance evidence and run preflight. Phase 3: HSM beta for early adopters, gather operational metrics for 30 days before GA.
evidence_package_requirements: Required artifacts for sign-off: runbook walkthrough video (<=15min), preflight report, integration test logs (saml, rbac, hsm), ndjson sample export for audit logs, security review PDF, customer acceptance email from pilot org.
